name: Kalandula Falls
subtitle: Kalandula Falls is a waterfall on the Lucala River in Malanje Province, northern Angola, roughly 100 metres high and 400 metres wide.

facts.label: Size
facts.value: About 100 metres drop across 400 metres width, on the Rio Lucala

facts.label: Names
facts.value: Quedas de Kalandula is the post-independence name for the falls known in the colonial period as Duque de Bragança

facts.label: Recognition
facts.value: Chosen in May 2014 as one of the seven wonders of Angola

facts.label: Inn
facts.value: Guesthouse built in the 1950s, now extended to 37 rooms

facts.label: Civil war closure
facts.value: The inn was closed for several decades because of the Angolan civil war

facts.label: Land recovery
facts.value: The project included recovering 500 hectares around the falls for farming

parts.text: Kalandula Falls is a waterfall on the Lucala River in Malanje Province, northern Angola, roughly 100 metres high and 400 metres wide. Under colonial rule it was known as the Duque de Bragança Falls. An inn built in the 1950s had been closed for decades because of the civil war and was reported working again in 2017.
